mostWorthwhile.text: Making new connective tissue connected the collagen gene and messenger RNA to protein production and wound support. The planned sequence made that familiar biology relevant to repair.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the new surface was predictable once the sheet and named slot were available, though it clearly showed the gap closing.

surprise.text: The reminder that newly formed tissue is not yet as strong as uninjured skin made repair feel less like an instant reset.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though the menu supplied compatibility rather than asking me to discover it. The purpose of clot-clearing enzymes was clear from their title and the remaining goal.

continue.text: I would probably continue: connecting gene expression to a visible repair was interesting, though several fitting steps were predictable.
